questions.stem: What is a major challenge of recycling plastics?

options.text: There are many different types of plastic that usually cannot be mixed, making sorting difficult
Recycled plastic is more expensive than gold
Plastics decompose too quickly to be collected

questions.explanation: Plastic recycling is challenged by the many different polymer types (PET, HDPE, PVC, LDPE, PP, PS, etc.) that usually cannot be mixed together during recycling. Sorting is difficult and expensive, contamination from food residue is problematic, and recycled plastic is often downcycled to lower-quality products.

options.text: An economy where products are used once and then thrown away
An economy where money circulates between banks
An economic system designed to eliminate waste by keeping materials in use and regenerating natural systems
An economy based entirely on recycling

questions.explanation: A circular economy replaces the traditional linear model (take-make-use-dispose) with a system where waste is designed out, materials are kept in use as long as possible, and natural systems are regenerated. Products are designed for durability, repair, disassembly, and recycling so that materials cycle back into production.
